_allowNames: 'Only on clean exit' is a logging radio, not an exit action. It is the single false positive introduced by matching DEFAULT_DENY case-insensitively (measured 2026-09-08 over all six caches), bought back here by name.

_titleHint: All four HTA windows are titled 'Medflow ...' (Login / Clinical System / Settings / Patient Detail). Since exePath is the shared host mshta.exe, this hint is the ONLY thing identifying the app -- _match_windows() drops its PID matcher when exeArgs is present.
_denyNames: EXIT / CLOSE / LOGOUT are already covered by DEFAULT_DENY now that it matches case-insensitively. Listed here only for the ones it cannot know: 확인 confirms the exit dialog.
_screens: project_medflow_coverage_plan's blocker #3: Tier 2 kills and relaunches the app per control, and Login is the only screen a fresh launch lands on. run_prefix() (common.py) replays these steps via direct COM UIA calls -- not physical capture, since they are setup, not the thing under test -- to reach Main/Settings before the harness goes near the control actually being tested. 2026-09-09: the credentials and the click/waitWindow sequence are smoke-tested against the real app via `enumerate --screen`; not yet run through Tier 2 itself (needs an Administrator PowerShell this session did not have).
